**A04 PASS** (medium), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:83, Repository identity and autocrlf. Round 6: PASS. Historical revision 4: PASS. Rationale: Git blob bytes need not equal the Windows worktree bytes; the two comparisons have different purposes. Required outcome: Retain the exact originals and let Git apply configured checkout conversion, blocking wrong host or unexpected content.
